description: Delete a specific Equipment Maintenance Log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the equipment maintenance log.

id.description: Unique identifier of this equipment maintenance log entry.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the maintenance log is associated with. Null for company-level maintenance logs.

managed_equipment_id.description: Identifier of the managed equipment item this maintenance log tracks.

last_service_date.description: Date the equipment was last serviced, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

next_service_date.description: Scheduled date for the next equipment service, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this maintenance log, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this maintenance log was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this maintenance log was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this maintenance log.

login.description: Email address (login) of the user who created this maintenance log.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this maintenance log.
